description: This file sets up the testing environment for a React project created with Create React App (CRA) using Jest. It loads necessary polyfills, testing libraries, and configures the Mock Service Worker (MSW) server lifecycle hooks.

methods.name: beforeAll
methods.description: Sets up the MSW server to start listening before tests run.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Resets MSW server handlers after each test to ensure test isolation.

methods.name: afterAll
methods.description: Closes the MSW server after all tests have completed.
